reuse.why: Adds one exported isHoliday next to getDateWithSkippedWeekend and routes all four existing holiday-membership checks through it.

duplication.why: The holiday match is defined once; the existing 'weekend or holiday' isSkippedDay closure is still repeated in three places, as before.

placement.why: The predicate lives in shared/schedules.ts with the other schedule date helpers, and the server imports it.

scope.why: Only the holiday matching, its call sites and two tests.

maintainability.why: Small and clear; a shared isSkippedDay would have removed the remaining repeated closures.
